title: Construction of module-valued tensor-section coordinates for line modules
statement: For schemes $X$ [def-pc-scheme] in the size convention [def-weil-size-convention], write $\operatorname{Inv}(X)$ for the full category of invertible modules [def-sc-invertible-module], with all module maps. On the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] put $\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}(u:U\to X)=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$. Write $\operatorname{Line}(X_{\mathrm{et}})$ for the full category of $\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] trivial on some arbitrary jointly surjective etale family. Let $S_X(L)$ be the actual tensor-section sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module], with its normalized restrictions, and let $c_{w,v}$ and $e_u$ be respectively the normalized tensor-pullback composition and structure-module isomorphisms for [def-pc-module-pullback], in the directions $w^*v^*\to(vw)^*$ and $u^*\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal O_U$. There exist functors $A_X:\operatorname{Inv}(X)\to\operatorname{Line}(X_{\mathrm{et}})$, additive sheaf isomorphisms $\alpha_{X,L}:A_X(L)_{\mathrm{Ab}}\simeq S_X(L)$, and module-sheaf isomorphisms $\epsilon_X:A_X(\mathcal O_X)\simeq\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}$. Every etale $v:Y\to X$ pulls invertible $L$ back to an invertible module, with witnesses $p_{v,L}$, and there are module-presheaf isomorphisms $\beta_{v,L}:A_X(L)|_{Y_{\mathrm{et}}}\simeq A_Y(v^*L)$. Here restriction evaluates at $w:W\to Y$ by $vw$. These data satisfy precisely the following coordinate requirements: $\alpha_{X,L,u}(rs)=r\alpha_{X,L,u}(s)$; for every module map $h:L\to K$, $\alpha_{X,K,u}(A_X(h)_u(s))=\Gamma(u^*h)(\alpha_{X,L,u}(s))$; $\epsilon_{X,u}(s)=\Gamma(e_u)(\alpha_{X,\mathcal O_X,u}(s))$; and $\alpha_{Y,v^*L,w}(\beta_{v,L,w}(s))=\Gamma(c_{w,v,L}^{-1})(\alpha_{X,L,vw}(s))$. No inverse-unit formula, coherence equation, or frames for every prescribed cover are asserted.

proof.text: Form the module presheaf on the actual tensor-section groups using the sectionwise scalar actions. Semilinearity gives module restrictions and quasi-coherent descent gives their sheaf condition. Naturality of the adjunction unit and of the composition comparison makes the sectionwise pulled-back module maps natural. Pullback functor laws give a functor on all module morphisms. Its underlying additive coordinate map is the identity.

The adjoint structure-module map is multiplication on local tensors with inverse inserting 1. The tensor-unit restriction equation gives its naturality, and linearity makes it a module-sheaf isomorphism epsilon. Its coordinate formula follows from its definition.

Compare tensor pullback with the ordinary module pullback by adjoint uniqueness. Ordinary pullback preserves Zariski rank-one trivializations, so tensor pullback preserves invertibility. At an etale w use sections of c_w,v inverse to define beta. Left-adjoint associativity and unit naturality give its restriction square; each component is linear. Its inverse is natural by cancellation.

Choose a Zariski trivializing cover. It is etale, and beta, the image of its frames, and epsilon trivialize the constructed module on the localized sites. The slice small-etale site at U -> X is the small-etale site of U by composition; its structure-ring maps are the same. This gives the line property. Restrict the constructed functor to these full subcategories.

theorem etale_line_sections_coordinates :
    ∃ (A : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, TrfInvertibleModules X ⥤ TrfEtaleLineModules X)
      (α : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : TrfInvertibleModules X),
        trfLineSections ((A X).obj L) ≅ trfInvertibleSections L)
      (ε : ∀ X : Scheme.{u},
          ((A X).obj (trfStructureInvertible X)).obj ≅
            SheafOfModules.unit (trfEtaleStructureRing X))
      (p : ∀ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (v : Y ⟶ X) [Etale v] (L : TrfInvertibleModules X),
          ((Modules.tensorPullback v).obj L.obj).IsInvertible)
        (β : ∀ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (v : Y ⟶ X) [Etale v] (L : TrfInvertibleModules X),
          (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀ (trfEtaleCompose v)
            (trfEtaleStructureRing X).obj).obj ((A X).obj L).obj.val ≅
          ((A Y).obj ⟨(Modules.tensorPullback v).obj L.obj, p X Y v L⟩).obj.val),
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : TrfInvertibleModules X) (U : X.Etale)
        (r : Γ(U.left, ⊤)) (s : ((A X).obj L).obj.val.obj (op U)),
        (α X L).hom.hom.app (op U) (r • s) =
          (((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj L.obj).smul r).hom
            ((α X L).hom.hom.app (op U) s)) ∧
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (L K : TrfInvertibleModules X) (h : L.obj ⟶ K.obj)
        (U : X.Etale) (s : ((A X).obj L).obj.val.obj (op U)),
        (α X K).hom.hom.app (op U)
          ((trfComparisonMap (A X) h).val.app (op U) s) =
        ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).map h).app ⊤ ((α X L).hom.hom.app (op U) s)) ∧
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Etale)
        (s : ((A X).obj (trfStructureInvertible X)).obj.val.obj (op U)),
        (ε X).hom.val.app (op U) s = (trfTensorUnit U.hom).hom.app ⊤
          ((α X (trfStructureInvertible X)).hom.hom.app (op U) s)) ∧
        (∀ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (v : Y ⟶ X) [Etale v] (L : TrfInvertibleModules X)
          (W : Y.Etale) (s : ((A X).obj L).obj.val.obj
            (op ((trfEtaleCompose v).obj W))),
          (α Y ⟨(Modules.tensorPullback v).obj L.obj, p X Y v L⟩).hom.hom.app (op W)
              ((β X Y v L).hom.app (op W) s) =
            ((Modules.tensorSectionsComp W.hom v).inv.app L.obj).app ⊤
              ((α X L).hom.hom.app (op ((trfEtaleCompose v).obj W)) s))
